question: Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word. **Ostentatious**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Modest .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"ostentatious"** means characterized by vulgar or pretentious display, designed to impress or attract notice.
